recipes.name: Creamy Pesto Chicken and Bow Ties
ingredients_raw: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast, cubed
1 (10.75 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Chicken Soup (Regular or 98% Fat Free)

steps.text: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Meanwhile, heat butter in skillet. Add chicken and cook until browned, stirring often.
Add soup, pesto sauce and milk. Bring to a boil. Cook over low heat 5 minutes or until done. Stir in drained pasta and heat through.

raw_recipe.headline: Creamy Pesto Chicken and Bow Ties
raw_recipe.description: Use Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Chicken Soup, chicken breast, and bow tie pasta to make an easy one-dish meal with a creamy pesto sauce.

review.reviewBody: Excellent! I sauteed spinach and mushrooms before adding in the chicken, which I cut into thin strips. I also added a can of petite diced garlic and olive oil tomatoes in at the end. This was definitely a restaurant quality meal!

I made this recipe for dinner last night and it was delicious. My wife, my food critic/critiquer, says "You should save this recipe," so that I did. I did make a couple changes. I sauteed about 2.5 cups of frozen vegetables(baby corn, brocolli, yellow squash)and 1.5 Tbs of minced garlic. I set this aside and then browned my chicken using EVOO as a healthier alternative to butter. During the cooking process I seasoned my chicken with Seasoning Salt, garlic powder, and Poultry Seasoning. I then added the sauteed vegetables and soup, milk,pesto, plus added about a third of a cup of white Moscato,and a cup of grated parmesan cheese(I made a double serving).

This was definitely ridiculously easy and the hubby loved it (needed a quick lunch to take to work the next day and had 2 thawed chicken breasts), so this is an awesome cabinet meal. I can see how tomatoes would be a nice addition (fresh or canned). Seasoned the chicken breast with Cavender's Greek seasoning (will use a bit more next time) with olive oil instead of butter and 8 oz crimini mushrooms. Froze half the sauce for later and will update on how it works out after we defrost and use it!
This was fantastic! I added fresh, diced tomatoes and fresh spinach in the last 5 minutes of cooking, and it came out great.

this was a huge hit. I am a college student living with two other girls. I was able to buy all the stuff I needed to make it for under 20$ (nice when living on a budget) I did however change it up a bit. instead of breasts I used boneless, skinless thighs because they are so much juicier. I sauteed the chicken in olive oil and wine then deglazed the pan with more wine. For the sauce I used cream of chicken mushroom soup, lots of pesto (someone had mentioned the soup slightly over powered the pesto), parmesan cheese, goat cheese and a touch more wine (can you see a theme here?) But it turned out amazingly. Definitely making this again soon.

This was delicious! Made a few changes from what others suggested- I added mushrooms and spinach and sautéed with garlic and olive oil before adding the chicken. Also used nearly two pounds of chicken and full pound of pasta (my guy can put some serious food away) .. But other than that, it was awesome! And I'm my worst critic for sure.. I'll take a little credit for This one :)

This recipe was quick & tasted great! I seasoned the chicken breast before cooking, & also added spinach & mushrooms when he chicken was almost done cooking (per another reviewers suggestion). My husband is picky, & he loved it too! Definitely a keeper!

Such a good recipe!! We used cavatappi pasta instead of bow ties because it was what we had in our pantry but still very good. I also added parmesan cheese as suggested by reviews and breadcrumbs on top and broiled it for about 3 minutes and it was excellent. Definitely will make again :)

This was quite good. I didn't have bowtie pasta so I used penne. I did saute onion before adding the chicken and added some garlic powder. I mixed in broccoli at the end and topped with parmesan cheese. Will probably make this again.
I used rice milk and a 1/4 cup of heavy whipping cream for added thickness, and thus added another 1/4 pesto. I also added some brocolli and cauliflower! By far my favorite pesto recipe!!
This is really good the way it is. Very simple and very fast. I added about 1/2 c sour cream and about 2 T. Worcestershire sauce, also a bit more pesto. This is going to be a keeper for me.
Excellent meal! A fresh side salad and crusty bread with butter made a perfect meal

This recipe was delicious! I did add some sauteed mushrooms, sundried tomatoes, peas, and a sprinkle of red pepper flakes. Would totally make again. The creamy chicken flavor balanced the pesto perfectly.
Very good! instead of milk I used heavy cream- Delicious
My husband and I had never tried pesto before so we were a bit hesitant. We both loved it! It will be a regular on our menu from now on! I am looking for more ways to use pesto!
I absolutely love this recipe. Very easy to make and has a very rich flavor . After making once I knew it was a keeper
Great recipe! I added zucchini and roasted peppers for some color. It was amazing, easy and delish , thanks for the recipe!
